info.title: YooDesk Edge local administration
info.description: Edge local identity is independent of Global business accounts and ICE. HTML form endpoints require exact Host/Origin, single-value fields, and independent Secure HttpOnly Strict cookies. Settings take effect after restart; registration approval remains authoritative at Global.

200.description: Setup form bound to independent browser cookie

303.description: Already initialized; redirect to local login

post.description: Requires csrf, setup_code, username, password and password_confirm. Setup code is available only in the protected Edge state directory. Password is 12-72 UTF-8 bytes and hashed with bcrypt cost 12. Initialization does not log in.

503.description: Storage unavailable; authorization closed until restart

200.description: Local login form; no Global connection required

post.description: Exactly csrf, username, password. Persistent sessions last at most eight hours. Duplicate local cookies are rejected.

303.description: Local session created; redirect to settings

200.description: Local settings and password forms; secrets never filled back

post.description: All actions require nonempty csrf and matching independent cookie. settings: revision, controller_url, global_issuer, authorization_origin, site_id, display_name, region, invitation; empty invitation retains saved secret. password: old_password, new_password; revokes all local sessions. logout removes current session. Unknown or repeated fields are rejected. No browser-selected node identity or ICE scope is accepted.

200.description: Settings saved, explicit service restart required

303.description: Password changed or logged out; redirect to login

get.description: Exactly one optional cursor; page size 50. Global derives the authenticated Edge and its approved descendant subtree, then checks the last authenticated attachment and the current site and owner policies. Offline devices remain listed. Each item identifies its attachment Edge. ICE and remote Viewer rights do not grant management scope.

200.description: HTML scoped online/offline device page; empty is valid

401.description: Local session required or revoked while waiting

503.description: Global directory unavailable; no stale success

post.description: Exact Origin and single-value csrf, device_id, expected_remark and remark fields. Global resolves the same subtree as for the device list, checks the current attachment and remark in a transaction, and audits the successful write. No account or remote session permission changes.

303.description: Remark saved; redirect to device page

401.description: Local administrator session or CSRF invalid

403.description: Device is outside current management scope

EdgeLocalSession.name: __Host-{product_id}_edge_admin_session
EdgeLocalSession.description: Independent Edge-only local session; never forward to Global. CSRF cookie is __Host-{product_id}_edge_admin_csrf; pre-login binding is __Host-{product_id}_edge_admin_binding.
